title: What an NFT Is
summary: An NFT, or non-fungible token, is a unique token that represents ownership of a specific item — art, a collectible, or access to something — recorded on a blockchain.
blocks: An NFT, or non-fungible token, is a unique token that represents ownership of a specific item — art, a collectible, or access to something — recorded on a blockchain.
Unlike a coin, where each unit is interchangeable, each NFT is distinct. That is what lets it stand in for a one-of-a-kind item.
What an NFT actually grants depends entirely on the project behind it; the token proves ownership of the entry on-chain, not necessarily any rights off-chain.
